seoTitle: Quote Image Maker: Text on a Background (PNG)
metaDescription: Make a quote card as a PNG: wrap text on a colour or gradient background with an author line in square, landscape or story sizes.
intro: Create shareable quote graphics without a design tool.
why:
Enter the quote and an optional author, choose a size (1080 by 1080, 1200 by 630 or 1080 by 1920), a gradient, paper, black or custom colour and a font family. The text is wrapped and sized to fit the safe area, with a quotation mark, and the image is saved as PNG.

Check that your text is not copyrighted material you may not republish, and give credit to the author.

The file is read in your browser and is not uploaded anywhere.
howTo: Add alt text with the quote when you post it.

faq.a: Square for feeds, landscape for link previews and story for vertical stories.

faq.q: Can I use my own colour?
faq.a: Yes, choose custom colour and enter a hex value.

faq.q: Is the text kept as text?
faq.a: No, it is baked into the image; add alt text.
The file is read in your browser and is not uploaded anywhere.
